==Description==
The '''Molten Monster''' is a {{Color|LegendaryConsumable}} [[Consumables|consumable]]. Upon use, the [[Molten Monster]] will be summoned on the path.

The '''Molten Monster''' has a use limit of one per player during a single match.

==Usage==
When using the '''Molten Monster''', it summons one [[Molten Monster]] from the exit. This unit can tank high amounts of enemies, as well as occasionally attack them with its claws at close range or fire fireballs at them, both attacks setting them on fire, which also drops their defense through burn. The unit has 20,000 health and walks slowly across the entire path. When enemies are nearby, it will stop to attack them. It will shoot fireballs at enemies in its larger main range of 50. When enemies are in its smaller, secondary range of 12, it will attack them with its claws.

==Strategy==
*The '''Molten Monster''' spawned can be helpful on the final wave, killing most or all of the enemies that spawn allowing your towers to focus solely on the boss.
*The '''Molten Monster''' can also be used in earlier waves, to allow players to focus on [[Farm|farming]] and building up defenses instead. 
*It is best to use the '''Molten Monster''' on a longer path, to ensure that as much of its ability is used at once. 

==Trivia==
*The '''Molten Monster''' is the second {{Color|LegendaryConsumable}} consumable in the game, with the first being the [[Nuke]].
**Similar to the [[Nuke]], the {{Color|LegendaryConsumable}} rarity has its text colored yellow, unlike the typical purple {{Color|Legendary}} rarity.
